en.explanation: Dilip Gavit won the gold medal in the Men's 100m T47 para-athletics event at the Commonwealth Games 2026 in Glasgow. He completed the race in 10.71 seconds, setting a new Commonwealth Games record and registering his season's best performance. His victory helped India secure its third gold medal of the Games. Mohammed Basil Morssinganakathi won the silver medal with a timing of 10.83 seconds, creating India's first-ever one-two finish in the Men's 100m T47 event. Murali Sreeshankar also added a silver medal in the men's long jump with a leap of 8.09 metres.

hi.question: राष्ट्रमंडल खेल 2026 में पुरुषों की 100 मीटर टी47 स्पर्धा में स्वर्ण पदक किसने जीता?
hi.explanation: दिलीप गावित ने Men's 100m T47 para-athletics event at the Commonwealth Games 2026 in Glasgow. He completed the race in 10.71 seconds, setting a new Commonwealth Games record and registering his season's में सर्वश्रेष्ठ प्रदर्शन करते हुए स्वर्ण पदक जीता। उनकी जीत से भारत को खेलों का तीसरा स्वर्ण पदक हासिल करने में मदद मिली। मोहम्मद बासिल मोर्सिंगनकाथी ने 10.83 सेकंड के समय के साथ रजत पदक जीता, जिससे भारत_ENG_THEME_TOKEN_1__s 100 मीटर T47 इवेंट बना। मुरली श्रीशंकर ने पुरुषों की लंबी कूद में 8.09 मीटर की छलांग लगाकर रजत पदक भी जीता।

gu.question: કોમનવેલ્થ ગેમ્સ 2026માં પુરુષોની 100 મીટર T47 સ્પર્ધામાં કોણે ગોલ્ડ મેડલ જીત્યો?
gu.explanation: દિલીપ ગાવિતે મેન્સ's 100m T47 para-athletics event at the Commonwealth Games 2026 in Glasgow. He completed the race in 10.71 seconds, setting a new Commonwealth Games record and registering his season'ના શ્રેષ્ઠ પ્રદર્શનમાં ગોલ્ડ મેડલ જીત્યો. તેની જીતથી ભારતને ગેમ્સનો ત્રીજો ગોલ્ડ મેડલ સુરક્ષિત કરવામાં મદદ મળી. મોહમ્મદ બાસિલ મોરસિંગનાકાથીએ 10.83 સેકન્ડના સમય સાથે ભારત's first-ever one-two finish in the Men'ની 100m T47 ઇવેન્ટ બનાવીને સિલ્વર મેડલ જીત્યો. મુરલી શ્રીશંકરે પણ પુરુષોની લાંબી કૂદમાં 8.09 મીટરની છલાંગ સાથે સિલ્વર મેડલ મેળવ્યો હતો.

en.question: Which state signed MoUs with HCL Technologies and Sarvam AI for a proposed investment of over ₹15,000 crore to promote AI and innovation in the IT sector?
en.explanation: Odisha signed Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with HCL Technologies and Sarvam AI on July 24, 2026, for a proposed investment exceeding ₹15,000 crore to strengthen the state's IT and Artificial Intelligence ecosystem. The project includes establishing a tech hub in Khurda district, a ₹14,257 crore AI Data Centre, and a Global Delivery Centre with an investment of ₹730 crore by HCL Technologies. The initiative also includes the Odisha Sovereign AI Park to support high-performance computing infrastructure and is expected to generate over 6,000 direct jobs. It aims to provide AI services in Odia and other Indian languages using indigenous AI technology.

hi.question: किस राज्य ने आईटी क्षेत्र में एआई और नवाचार को बढ़ावा देने के लिए ₹15,000 करोड़ से अधिक के प्रस्तावित निवेश के लिए एचसीएल टेक्नोलॉजीज और सर्वम एआई के साथ समझौता ज्ञापन पर हस्ताक्षर किए?
hi.explanation: ओडिशा ने राज्य के आईटी और आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस इकोसिस्टम को मजबूत करने के लिए ₹15,000 करोड़ से अधिक के प्रस्तावित निवेश के लिए 24 जुलाई, 2026 को एचसीएल टेक्नोलॉजीज और सर्वम एआई के साथ समझौता ज्ञापन (एमओयू) पर हस्ताक्षर किए। इस परियोजना में खुर्दा जिले में एक टेक हब, ₹14,257 करोड़ का एआई डेटा सेंटर और एचसीएल टेक्नोलॉजीज द्वारा ₹730 करोड़ के निवेश के साथ एक ग्लोबल डिलीवरी सेंटर की स्थापना शामिल है। इस पहल में उच्च-प्रदर्शन कंप्यूटिंग बुनियादी ढांचे का समर्थन करने के लिए ओडिशा सॉवरेन एआई पार्क भी शामिल है और इससे 6,000 से अधिक प्रत्यक्ष नौकरियां पैदा होने की उम्मीद है। इसका उद्देश्य स्वदेशी एआई तकनीक का उपयोग करके ओडिया और अन्य भारतीय भाषाओं में एआई सेवाएं प्रदान करना है।

gu.question: કયા રાજ્યે IT સેક્ટરમાં AI અને નવીનતાને પ્રોત્સાહન આપવા માટે ₹15,000 કરોડથી વધુના પ્રસ્તાવિત રોકાણ માટે HCL ટેક્નોલોજીસ અને સર્વમ AI સાથે એમઓયુ પર હસ્તાક્ષર કર્યા?
gu.explanation: રાજ્યની IT અને આર્ટિફિશિયલ ઇન્ટેલિજન્સ ઇકોસિસ્ટમને મજબૂત કરવા માટે ₹15,000 કરોડથી વધુના પ્રસ્તાવિત રોકાણ માટે ઓડિશાએ 24 જુલાઈ, 2026ના રોજ HCL ટેક્નૉલોજિસ અને સર્વમ AI સાથે મેમોરેન્ડમ ઑફ અન્ડરસ્ટેન્ડિંગ (એમઓયુ) પર હસ્તાક્ષર કર્યા હતા. પ્રોજેક્ટમાં ખુર્દા જિલ્લામાં ટેક હબની સ્થાપના, ₹14,257 કરોડનું AI ડેટા સેન્ટર અને HCL ટેક્નોલોજીસ દ્વારા ₹730 કરોડના રોકાણ સાથે વૈશ્વિક ડિલિવરી સેન્ટરનો સમાવેશ થાય છે. આ પહેલમાં ઉચ્ચ-પ્રદર્શન કમ્પ્યુટિંગ ઈન્ફ્રાસ્ટ્રક્ચરને ટેકો આપવા માટે ઓડિશા સોવરિન એઆઈ પાર્કનો પણ સમાવેશ થાય છે અને તે 6,000 થી વધુ સીધી નોકરીઓનું સર્જન કરે તેવી અપેક્ષા છે. તેનો હેતુ સ્વદેશી AI ટેક્નોલોજીનો ઉપયોગ કરીને ઓડિયા અને અન્ય ભારતીય ભાષાઓમાં AI સેવાઓ પ્રદાન કરવાનો છે.

en.question: Which company launched the 'Drishti' digital platform to strengthen credit decision-making across retail and MSME lending?
en.explanation: Axis Finance Limited (AFL), a wholly owned subsidiary of Axis Bank, launched the in-house digital lending platform 'Axis Finance Drishti' in July 2026. Developed as a Business Rules Engine (BRE), the platform automates and standardises credit decision-making using advanced analytics, statistical scorecards, and multiple data sources for accurate risk assessment. It supports real-time decision-making and Straight-Through Processing (STP), improving lending speed, consistency, and operational efficiency. In its first phase, the platform has been deployed for Personal Loans, Business Loans, Loan Against Property (LAP), and Disha Home Loans, enabling faster and data-driven loan approvals.

hi.question: खुदरा और एमएसएमई ऋण देने में क्रेडिट निर्णय लेने को मजबूत करने के लिए किस कंपनी ने 'Drishti' डिजिटल प्लेटफॉर्म लॉन्च किया?
hi.explanation: एक्सिस बैंक की पूर्ण स्वामित्व वाली सहायक कंपनी एक्सिस फाइनेंस लिमिटेड (एएफएल) ने जुलाई 2026 में इन-हाउस डिजिटल लेंडिंग प्लेटफॉर्म 'Axis Finance Drishti' लॉन्च किया। बिजनेस रूल्स इंजन (बीआरई) के रूप में विकसित, प्लेटफॉर्म सटीक जोखिम मूल्यांकन के लिए उन्नत एनालिटिक्स, सांख्यिकीय स्कोरकार्ड और कई डेटा स्रोतों का उपयोग करके क्रेडिट निर्णय लेने को स्वचालित और मानकीकृत करता है। यह वास्तविक समय में निर्णय लेने और स्ट्रेट-थ्रू प्रोसेसिंग (एसटीपी) का समर्थन करता है, जिससे ऋण देने की गति, स्थिरता और परिचालन दक्षता में सुधार होता है। अपने पहले चरण में, प्लेटफ़ॉर्म को व्यक्तिगत ऋण, व्यवसाय ऋण, संपत्ति पर ऋण (एलएपी), और दिशा होम लोन के लिए तैनात किया गया है, जिससे तेज़ और डेटा-संचालित ऋण अनुमोदन सक्षम हो सके।

gu.question: રિટેલ અને MSME ધિરાણમાં ક્રેડિટ નિર્ણય લેવાને મજબૂત કરવા માટે કઈ કંપનીએ 'Drishti' ડિજિટલ પ્લેટફોર્મ લોન્ચ કર્યું?
gu.explanation: એક્સિસ બેંકની સંપૂર્ણ માલિકીની પેટાકંપની, એક્સિસ ફાઇનાન્સ લિમિટેડ (એએફએલ) એ જુલાઈ 2026 માં ઇન-હાઉસ ડિજિટલ ધિરાણ પ્લેટફોર્મ 'Axis Finance Drishti' લોન્ચ કર્યું હતું. બિઝનેસ રૂલ્સ એન્જિન (BRE) તરીકે વિકસિત, પ્લેટફોર્મ અદ્યતન એક્યુર સ્ટેટિસ્ટિક સ્કોર અને મલ્ટિપલ સ્ટેટિસ્ટિક ડેટા, મલ્ટીપલ રિસ્ક ડેટાનો ઉપયોગ કરીને ક્રેડિટ નિર્ણય લેવાનું સ્વચાલિત કરે છે અને માનક બનાવે છે. આકારણી તે ધિરાણની ઝડપ, સાતત્ય અને કાર્યક્ષમતા સુધારીને રિયલ-ટાઇમ નિર્ણય લેવા અને સ્ટ્રેટ-થ્રુ પ્રોસેસિંગ (STP)ને સપોર્ટ કરે છે. તેના પ્રથમ તબક્કામાં, પ્લેટફોર્મ પર્સનલ લોન, બિઝનેસ લોન્સ, લોન અગેન્સ્ટ પ્રોપર્ટી (LAP) અને દિશા હોમ લોન માટે તૈનાત કરવામાં આવ્યું છે, જે ઝડપી અને ડેટા આધારિત લોન મંજૂરીઓને સક્ષમ કરે છે.

en.question: Which state became the first in India to qualify for the second instalment of Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY) funds in 2026?
en.explanation: Maharashtra became the first state in India to qualify for the second instalment of Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY) funds after achieving more than 75% utilisation of the first instalment within the stipulated time. The state received ₹335 crore as the first instalment, utilised approximately ₹260 crore, and became eligible for another ₹335 crore. Maharashtra also demonstrated strong performance in Farmer ID generation and the Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH). Additionally, it provided ₹14,000 crore in direct financial assistance to flood-affected farmers through bank transfers within five days, showcasing efficient implementation of agricultural support initiatives.

hi.question: 2026 में राष्ट्रीय कृषि विकास योजना (आरकेवीवाई) निधि की दूसरी किस्त के लिए अर्हता प्राप्त करने वाला भारत का पहला राज्य कौन सा बन गया?
hi.explanation: निर्धारित समय के भीतर पहली किस्त का 75% से अधिक उपयोग हासिल करने के बाद महाराष्ट्र राष्ट्रीय कृषि विकास योजना (आरकेवीवाई) फंड की दूसरी किस्त के लिए अर्हता प्राप्त करने वाला भारत का पहला राज्य बन गया। राज्य को पहली किस्त के रूप में ₹335 करोड़ प्राप्त हुए, लगभग ₹260 करोड़ का उपयोग किया गया और वह अन्य ₹335 करोड़ के लिए पात्र हो गया। महाराष्ट्र ने किसान आईडी निर्माण और एकीकृत बागवानी विकास मिशन (एमआईडीएच) में भी मजबूत प्रदर्शन किया। इसके अतिरिक्त, इसने कृषि सहायता पहल के कुशल कार्यान्वयन को प्रदर्शित करते हुए, पांच दिनों के भीतर बैंक हस्तांतरण के माध्यम से बाढ़ प्रभावित किसानों को प्रत्यक्ष वित्तीय सहायता में ₹14,000 करोड़ प्रदान किए।

gu.question: 2026 માં રાષ્ટ્રીય કૃષિ વિકાસ યોજના (RKVY) ભંડોળના બીજા હપ્તા માટે લાયકાત મેળવનાર ભારતમાં કયું રાજ્ય પ્રથમ બન્યું?
gu.explanation: નિર્ધારિત સમયની અંદર પ્રથમ હપ્તાનો 75% કરતા વધુ ઉપયોગ હાંસલ કર્યા પછી રાષ્ટ્રીય કૃષિ વિકાસ યોજના (RKVY) ફંડના બીજા હપ્તા માટે લાયકાત મેળવનાર મહારાષ્ટ્ર ભારતનું પ્રથમ રાજ્ય બન્યું. રાજ્યને પ્રથમ હપ્તા તરીકે ₹335 કરોડ મળ્યા, આશરે ₹260 કરોડનો ઉપયોગ કર્યો અને અન્ય ₹335 કરોડ માટે પાત્ર બન્યું. મહારાષ્ટ્રે ફાર્મર આઈડી જનરેશન અને મિશન ફોર ઈન્ટીગ્રેટેડ ડેવલપમેન્ટ ઑફ હોર્ટિકલ્ચર (MIDH)માં પણ મજબૂત કામગીરી દર્શાવી છે. વધુમાં, તેણે પાંચ દિવસમાં બેંક ટ્રાન્સફર દ્વારા પૂરથી અસરગ્રસ્ત ખેડૂતોને ₹14,000 કરોડની સીધી નાણાકીય સહાય પૂરી પાડી હતી, જે કૃષિ સહાયક પહેલના કાર્યક્ષમ અમલીકરણને દર્શાવે છે.

en.question: Which state authorised the issuance of the Family Register Certificate through the MeeSeva platform in July 2026?
en.explanation: Telangana authorised the issuance of the Telangana Family Register Certificate through the MeeSeva platform on July 28, 2026, to ensure uniform verification of family records across the state. Issued by the Revenue Department, the electronic Family Register captures details such as Aadhaar number, date of birth, gender, and relationship to the head of the family, with the Family Register Identification Number matching the family's Ration Card Number. Citizens can obtain the certificate through MeeSeva centres or mobile applications by paying a user fee of ₹62. The certificate is also recognised by the Election Commission of India as one of the accepted documents for the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls.

hi.question: जुलाई 2026 में किस राज्य ने मीसेवा प्लेटफॉर्म के माध्यम से परिवार रजिस्टर प्रमाणपत्र जारी करने को अधिकृत किया?
hi.explanation: तेलंगाना ने राज्य भर में पारिवारिक रिकॉर्ड का एक समान सत्यापन सुनिश्चित करने के लिए 28 जुलाई, 2026 को मीसेवा प्लेटफॉर्म के माध्यम से तेलंगाना परिवार रजिस्टर प्रमाणपत्र जारी करने को अधिकृत किया। राजस्व विभाग द्वारा जारी, इलेक्ट्रॉनिक परिवार रजिस्टर में आधार संख्या, जन्म तिथि, लिंग और परिवार के मुखिया से संबंध जैसे विवरण शामिल होते हैं, जिसमें परिवार रजिस्टर पहचान संख्या परिवार के राशन कार्ड नंबर से मेल खाती है। नागरिक मीसेवा केंद्रों या मोबाइल एप्लिकेशन के माध्यम से ₹62 का उपयोगकर्ता शुल्क देकर प्रमाणपत्र प्राप्त कर सकते हैं। इस प्रमाणपत्र को भारत के चुनाव आयोग द्वारा मतदाता सूची के विशेष गहन पुनरीक्षण के लिए स्वीकृत दस्तावेजों में से एक के रूप में भी मान्यता प्राप्त है।

gu.question: કયા રાજ્યએ જુલાઈ 2026 માં મીસેવા પ્લેટફોર્મ દ્વારા ફેમિલી રજિસ્ટર પ્રમાણપત્ર જારી કરવાની અધિકૃતતા આપી?
gu.explanation: સમગ્ર રાજ્યમાં કૌટુંબિક રેકોર્ડની એકસમાન ચકાસણી સુનિશ્ચિત કરવા માટે તેલંગાણાએ 28 જુલાઈ, 2026ના રોજ મીસેવા પ્લેટફોર્મ દ્વારા તેલંગાણા ફેમિલી રજિસ્ટર પ્રમાણપત્ર જારી કરવાની અધિકૃતતા આપી હતી. મહેસૂલ વિભાગ દ્વારા જારી કરાયેલ, ઈલેક્ટ્રોનિક ફેમિલી રજિસ્ટર કુટુંબના રેશન કાર્ડ નંબર સાથે મેળ ખાતા કુટુંબ રજિસ્ટર ઓળખ નંબર સાથે આધાર નંબર, જન્મ તારીખ, લિંગ અને કુટુંબના વડા સાથેના સંબંધ જેવી વિગતો મેળવે છે. નાગરિકો ₹62 ની વપરાશકર્તા ફી ચૂકવીને મીસેવા કેન્દ્રો અથવા મોબાઇલ એપ્લિકેશન દ્વારા પ્રમાણપત્ર મેળવી શકે છે. પ્રમાણપત્રને ભારતના ચૂંટણી પંચ દ્વારા મતદાર યાદીના વિશેષ સઘન સંશોધન માટે સ્વીકૃત દસ્તાવેજોમાંના એક તરીકે પણ માન્યતા આપવામાં આવી છે.

en.question: What global toy market share has the Toy Sector Task Force targeted for India by 2032?
en.explanation: The Toy Sector Task Force, announced by Union Minister Piyush Goyal on July 27, 2026, has set a target of achieving a 5% share in the global toy market by 2032. The initiative aims to strengthen India's toy manufacturing ecosystem by integrating with global value chains, promoting innovation and design, resolving supply chain bottlenecks, and developing a skilled workforce. A comprehensive Toy Sector Playbook has also been launched to guide MSMEs, startups, and investors on manufacturing standards, intellectual property, compliance, and export opportunities. The initiative is expected to enhance India's competitiveness and establish the country as a major global toy manufacturing hub.

hi.question: खिलौना सेक्टर टास्क फोर्स ने 2032 तक भारत के लिए वैश्विक खिलौना बाजार में कितनी हिस्सेदारी का लक्ष्य रखा है?
hi.explanation: 27 जुलाई, 2026 को केंद्रीय मंत्री पीयूष गोयल द्वारा घोषित खिलौना सेक्टर टास्क फोर्स ने 2032 तक वैश्विक खिलौना बाजार में 5% हिस्सेदारी हासिल करने का लक्ष्य रखा है। इस पहल का उद्देश्य भारत_ENG_THEME_TOKEN_0__ की प्रतिस्पर्धात्मकता को मजबूत करना और देश को एक प्रमुख वैश्विक खिलौना विनिर्माण केंद्र के रूप में स्थापित करना है।

gu.question: ટોય સેક્ટર ટાસ્ક ફોર્સે 2032 સુધીમાં ભારત માટે કયા વૈશ્વિક રમકડા બજારનો હિસ્સો નક્કી કર્યો છે?
gu.explanation: 27 જુલાઈ, 2026ના રોજ કેન્દ્રીય મંત્રી પિયુષ ગોયલ દ્વારા જાહેર કરાયેલ ટોય સેક્ટર ટાસ્ક ફોર્સે 2032 સુધીમાં વૈશ્વિક રમકડા બજારમાં 5% હિસ્સો હાંસલ કરવાનો લક્ષ્યાંક નક્કી કર્યો છે. આ પહેલનો ઉદ્દેશ્ય ભારત's toy manufacturing ecosystem by integrating with global value chains, promoting innovation and design, resolving supply chain bottlenecks, and developing a skilled workforce. A comprehensive Toy Sector Playbook has also been launched to guide MSMEs, startups, and investors on manufacturing standards, intellectual property, compliance, and export opportunities. The initiative is expected to enhance India'ની સ્પર્ધાત્મકતાને મજબૂત કરવાનો છે અને દેશને એક મુખ્ય વૈશ્વિક રમકડા ઉત્પાદક તરીકે સ્થાપિત કરવાનો છે.

en.question: Which country formally notified the United Nations of its decision to withdraw from the Rome Statute and exit the International Criminal Court (ICC)?
en.explanation: Venezuela formally notified the United Nations of its decision to withdraw from the Rome Statute, the treaty that established the International Criminal Court (ICC). The announcement was made by Foreign Minister Felix Plasencia on the instructions of Interim President Delcy Rodríguez. The Venezuelan government cited concerns over the ICC's alleged geographical bias and questioned its impartiality. Under Article 127 of the Rome Statute, the withdrawal will take effect one year after notification and will not affect investigations already underway. Therefore, the ICC's ongoing investigation into alleged crimes against humanity in Venezuela, initiated in 2021, will continue despite the country's withdrawal.

hi.question: किस देश ने रोम संविधि से हटने और अंतर्राष्ट्रीय आपराधिक न्यायालय (आईसीसी) से बाहर निकलने के अपने फैसले के बारे में संयुक्त राष्ट्र को औपचारिक रूप से सूचित किया?
hi.explanation: वेनेजुएला ने औपचारिक रूप से संयुक्त राष्ट्र को रोम संविधि से हटने के अपने फैसले के बारे में सूचित किया, वह संधि जिसने अंतर्राष्ट्रीय आपराधिक न्यायालय (आईसीसी) की स्थापना की थी। अंतरिम राष्ट्रपति डेल्सी रोड्रिग्ज के निर्देश पर विदेश मंत्री फेलिक्स प्लासेनिया ने यह घोषणा की। वेनेजुएला सरकार ने वेनेजुएला में मानवता के खिलाफ कथित अपराधों की ICC's alleged geographical bias and questioned its impartiality. Under Article 127 of the Rome Statute, the withdrawal will take effect one year after notification and will not affect investigations already underway. Therefore, the ICC's चल रही जांच पर चिंताओं का हवाला दिया, जो 2021 में शुरू की गई थी, देश की वापसी के बावजूद जारी रहेगी।

gu.question: કયા દેશે ઔપચારિક રીતે યુનાઇટેડ નેશન્સને રોમ કાનૂનમાંથી ખસી જવા અને ઇન્ટરનેશનલ ક્રિમિનલ કોર્ટ (ICC)માંથી બહાર નીકળવાના નિર્ણયની સૂચના આપી?
gu.explanation: વેનેઝુએલાએ ઔપચારિક રીતે યુનાઇટેડ નેશન્સને રોમ સ્ટેચ્યુટમાંથી ખસી જવાના નિર્ણયની સૂચના આપી, જે સંધિએ આંતરરાષ્ટ્રીય ફોજદારી અદાલત (ICC) ની સ્થાપના કરી. વચગાળાના રાષ્ટ્રપતિ ડેલ્સી રોડ્રિગ્ઝની સૂચના પર વિદેશ પ્રધાન ફેલિક્સ પ્લેસેન્સિયા દ્વારા આ જાહેરાત કરવામાં આવી હતી. વેનેઝુએલાની સરકારે ICC's alleged geographical bias and questioned its impartiality. Under Article 127 of the Rome Statute, the withdrawal will take effect one year after notification and will not affect investigations already underway. Therefore, the ICC' ની વેનેઝુએલામાં 2021 માં શરૂ કરાયેલ માનવતા વિરુદ્ધના કથિત ગુનાઓની ચાલી રહેલી તપાસ અંગે ચિંતા દર્શાવી, દેશની ઉપાડ છતાં ચાલુ રહેશે.

en.question: Which institution designed and deployed the ANNAM.AI AI-powered smart weather stations for Kerala's climate-smart agriculture initiative?
en.explanation: IIT Ropar designed and deployed the ANNAM.AI AI-powered hyper-local weather intelligence system for the Kerala government's climate-smart agriculture initiative launched on July 28, 2026. Introduced as part of the state's 100-day action plan, the system provides real-time weather data and localised advisories to help farmers make informed decisions regarding sowing, irrigation, harvesting, and crop protection. The initiative aims to enhance agricultural resilience, reduce crop losses, and improve farm productivity through data-driven decision-making. Established in 2008 in Rupnagar, Punjab, IIT Ropar is one of India's second-generation Indian Institutes of Technology operating under the Ministry of Education.

hi.question: किस संस्था ने केरल की जलवायु-स्मार्ट कृषि पहल के लिए ANNAM.AI AI-संचालित स्मार्ट मौसम स्टेशनों को डिजाइन और तैनात किया?
hi.explanation: आईआईटी रोपड़ ने केरल सरकार_ENG_THEME_TOKEN_0__ की 100-दिवसीय कार्य योजना के लिए ANNAM.AI AI-संचालित हाइपर-स्थानीय मौसम खुफिया प्रणाली को डिजाइन और तैनात किया, यह प्रणाली किसानों को बुआई, सिंचाई, कटाई और फसल सुरक्षा के संबंध में सूचित निर्णय लेने में मदद करने के लिए वास्तविक समय का मौसम डेटा और स्थानीय सलाह प्रदान करती है। इस पहल का उद्देश्य डेटा-संचालित निर्णय-प्रक्रिया के माध्यम से कृषि लचीलेपन को बढ़ाना, फसल के नुकसान को कम करना और कृषि उत्पादकता में सुधार करना है। 2008 में रूपनगर, पंजाब में स्थापित, आईआईटी रोपड़ शिक्षा मंत्रालय के तहत संचालित भारत की दूसरी पीढ़ी के भारतीय प्रौद्योगिकी संस्थानों में से एक है।

gu.question: કઈ સંસ્થાએ કેરળની આબોહવા-સ્માર્ટ એગ્રીકલ્ચર પહેલ માટે ANNAM.AI AI-સંચાલિત સ્માર્ટ વેધર સ્ટેશનની રચના અને તૈનાત કરી?
gu.explanation: IIT રોપારે કેરળ સરકાર's climate-smart agriculture initiative launched on July 28, 2026. Introduced as part of the state'ની 100-દિવસીય એક્શન પ્લાન માટે ANNAM.AI AI-સંચાલિત હાઇપર-લોકલ વેધર ઇન્ટેલિજન્સ સિસ્ટમ ડિઝાઇન અને તૈનાત કરી, આ સિસ્ટમ ખેડૂતોને વાવણી, સિંચાઈ અને પાકના રક્ષણ, કાપણી અંગે માહિતગાર નિર્ણયો લેવામાં મદદ કરવા માટે વાસ્તવિક સમયનો હવામાન ડેટા અને સ્થાનિક સલાહ પ્રદાન કરે છે. આ પહેલનો ઉદ્દેશ્ય કૃષિ સ્થિતિસ્થાપકતા વધારવાનો, પાકના નુકસાનને ઘટાડવાનો અને ડેટા આધારિત નિર્ણયો દ્વારા કૃષિ ઉત્પાદકતામાં સુધારો કરવાનો છે. પંજાબના રૂપનગરમાં 2008માં સ્થપાયેલ, IIT રોપર એ શિક્ષણ મંત્રાલય હેઠળ કાર્યરત ભારતની બીજી પેઢીની ઈન્ડિયન ઈન્સ્ટિટ્યૂટ ઓફ ટેકનોલોજીમાંની એક છે.

en.question: Which state launched the Mukhyamantri Machhuara Samman Nidhi Yojana to provide financial assistance to fishermen during the annual fishing ban period?
en.explanation: Himachal Pradesh launched the Mukhyamantri Machhuara Samman Nidhi Yojana on July 29, 2026, under the leadership of Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu. The scheme provides annual financial assistance of ₹3,500 to eligible fishermen to support their household needs during the closed fishing season. Around 3,700 fisherman families dependent on major reservoirs such as Gobind Sagar, Pong Dam, Kol Dam, Chamera, and Ranjit Sagar are expected to benefit. The state has allocated an annual budget of approximately ₹1.20 crore for the scheme, which also promotes sustainable fisheries by supporting fishermen during the breeding season when fishing is prohibited.

hi.question: वार्षिक मछली पकड़ने पर प्रतिबंध अवधि के दौरान मछुआरों को वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करने के लिए किस राज्य ने मुख्यमंत्री मछुआरा सम्मान निधि योजना शुरू की?
hi.explanation: हिमाचल प्रदेश ने मुख्यमंत्री सुखविंदर सिंह सुक्खू के नेतृत्व में 29 जुलाई, 2026 को मुख्यमंत्री मछुआरा सम्मान निधि योजना शुरू की। यह योजना मछली पकड़ने के बंद मौसम के दौरान पात्र मछुआरों को उनकी घरेलू जरूरतों को पूरा करने के लिए ₹3,500 की वार्षिक वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करती है। गोबिंद सागर, पोंग बांध, कोल बांध, चमेरा और रंजीत सागर जैसे प्रमुख जलाशयों पर निर्भर लगभग 3,700 मछुआरे परिवारों को लाभ होने की उम्मीद है। राज्य ने इस योजना के लिए लगभग ₹1.20 करोड़ का वार्षिक बजट आवंटित किया है, जो मछली पकड़ने पर प्रतिबंध होने पर प्रजनन के मौसम के दौरान मछुआरों को समर्थन देकर टिकाऊ मत्स्य पालन को भी बढ़ावा देता है।

gu.question: વાર્ષિક માછીમારી પ્રતિબંધ સમયગાળા દરમિયાન માછીમારોને આર્થિક સહાય પૂરી પાડવા માટે કયા રાજ્યે મુખ્ય મંત્રી મચ્છુઆરા સન્માન નિધિ યોજના શરૂ કરી?
gu.explanation: હિમાચલ પ્રદેશે 29 જુલાઈ, 2026 ના રોજ મુખ્ય પ્રધાન સુખવિંદર સિંહ સુખુના નેતૃત્વ હેઠળ મુખ્ય પ્રધાન મછુઆરા સન્માન નિધિ યોજના શરૂ કરી. આ યોજના બંધ માછીમારીની મોસમ દરમિયાન તેમની ઘરની જરૂરિયાતોને ટેકો આપવા પાત્ર માછીમારોને ₹3,500 ની વાર્ષિક નાણાકીય સહાય પૂરી પાડે છે. ગોવિંદ સાગર, પોંગ ડેમ, કોલ ડેમ, ચમેરા અને રણજીત સાગર જેવા મોટા જળાશયો પર નિર્ભર આશરે 3,700 માછીમાર પરિવારોને લાભ થવાની અપેક્ષા છે. રાજ્યએ આ યોજના માટે અંદાજે ₹1.20 કરોડનું વાર્ષિક બજેટ ફાળવ્યું છે, જે માછીમારી પર પ્રતિબંધ હોય ત્યારે સંવર્ધન સીઝન દરમિયાન માછીમારોને ટેકો આપીને ટકાઉ મત્સ્યઉછેરને પણ પ્રોત્સાહન આપે છે.

en.question: Which bank is set to become the first Indian bank in 2026 to issue Basel III-compliant AT-1 Perpetual Bonds?
en.explanation: State Bank of India (SBI) is set to become the first Indian bank in 2026 to issue Basel III-compliant Additional Tier-I (AT-1) Perpetual Bonds. Through this issuance, SBI plans to raise ₹5,000 crore as part of its ₹60,000 crore capital-raising programme for FY 2026–27. The bonds will include a five-year call option, subject to regulatory approval. AT-1 Perpetual Bonds help banks strengthen their capital base, improve the Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR), comply with Basel III regulations, and enhance their capacity to absorb financial losses. The initiative will also support SBI's future lending, business expansion, and long-term financial resilience.

hi.question: कौन सा बैंक 2026 में बेसल III-अनुपालक AT-1 सतत बांड जारी करने वाला पहला भारतीय बैंक बनने के लिए तैयार है?
hi.explanation: भारतीय स्टेट बैंक (SBI) 2026 में बेसल III-अनुपालक अतिरिक्त टियर-I (AT-1) सतत बांड जारी करने वाला पहला भारतीय बैंक बनने के लिए तैयार है। इस निर्गम के माध्यम से, एसबीआई ने वित्त वर्ष 2026-27 के लिए अपने ₹60,000 करोड़ पूंजी जुटाने के कार्यक्रम के हिस्से के रूप में ₹5,000 करोड़ जुटाने की योजना बनाई है। बांड में विनियामक अनुमोदन के अधीन पांच साल का कॉल विकल्प शामिल होगा। एटी-1 सतत बांड बैंकों को अपने पूंजी आधार को मजबूत करने, पूंजी पर्याप्तता अनुपात (सीएआर) में सुधार करने, बेसल III नियमों का अनुपालन करने और वित्तीय घाटे को अवशोषित करने की उनकी क्षमता बढ़ाने में मदद करते हैं। यह पहल एसबीआई के भविष्य के ऋण, व्यापार विस्तार और दीर्घकालिक वित्तीय लचीलेपन का भी समर्थन करेगी।

gu.question: કઈ બેંક 2026 માં બેઝલ III-અનુસંગત AT-1 પર્પેચ્યુઅલ બોન્ડ્સ જારી કરનાર પ્રથમ ભારતીય બેંક બનવાની છે?
gu.explanation: સ્ટેટ બેંક ઓફ ઈન્ડિયા (SBI) 2026 માં બેસલ III-અનુસંગત વધારાના ટાયર-I (AT-1) પર્પેચ્યુઅલ બોન્ડ્સ જારી કરનાર પ્રથમ ભારતીય બેંક બનવાની તૈયારીમાં છે. આ ઈસ્યુ દ્વારા, SBI નાણાકીય વર્ષ 2026-27 માટે તેના ₹60,000 કરોડના મૂડી-ઉપાડ કાર્યક્રમના ભાગરૂપે ₹5,000 કરોડ એકત્ર કરવાની યોજના ધરાવે છે. આ બોન્ડમાં નિયમનકારી મંજૂરીને આધીન પાંચ વર્ષનો કોલ વિકલ્પ સામેલ હશે. AT-1 પર્પેચ્યુઅલ બોન્ડ્સ બેંકોને તેમના મૂડી આધારને મજબૂત કરવામાં, કેપિટલ એડક્વેસી રેશિયો (CAR) સુધારવા, બેસલ III ના નિયમોનું પાલન કરવામાં અને નાણાકીય નુકસાનને શોષવાની તેમની ક્ષમતા વધારવામાં મદદ કરે છે. આ પહેલ SBIના ભાવિ ધિરાણ, વ્યવસાયના વિસ્તરણ અને લાંબા ગાળાની નાણાકીય સ્થિતિસ્થાપકતાને પણ સમર્થન આપશે.

en.question: Which UAE tourist attraction became the first to accept UPI for online ticket bookings in July 2026?
en.explanation: Burj Khalifa became the first tourist attraction in the United Arab Emirates to accept UPI for online ticket bookings on July 29, 2026. The initiative was launched through a partnership between NPCI International Payments Limited (NIPL), NEOPAY, and Emaar Entertainment. It marked the first use of UPI for e-commerce transactions in the GCC region, enabling Indian travellers to purchase tickets in Indian currency through UPI apps before arriving in Dubai. This development expands the global reach of India's digital payment ecosystem.

hi.question: जुलाई 2026 में यूएई का कौन सा पर्यटक आकर्षण ऑनलाइन टिकट बुकिंग के लिए यूपीआई स्वीकार करने वाला पहला पर्यटक स्थल बन गया?
hi.explanation: बुर्ज खलीफा 29 जुलाई, 2026 को ऑनलाइन टिकट बुकिंग के लिए यूपीआई स्वीकार करने वाला संयुक्त अरब अमीरात का पहला पर्यटक आकर्षण बन गया। यह पहल एनपीसीआई इंटरनेशनल पेमेंट्स लिमिटेड (एनआईपीएल), नियोपे और एम्मार एंटरटेनमेंट के बीच साझेदारी के माध्यम से शुरू की गई थी। यह जीसीसी क्षेत्र में ई-कॉमर्स लेनदेन के लिए यूपीआई के पहले उपयोग को चिह्नित करता है, जिससे भारतीय यात्री दुबई पहुंचने से पहले यूपीआई ऐप्स के माध्यम से भारतीय मुद्रा में टिकट खरीद सकते हैं। यह विकास भारत के डिजिटल भुगतान पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र की वैश्विक पहुंच का विस्तार करता है।

gu.question: જુલાઈ 2026માં ઓનલાઈન ટિકિટ બુકિંગ માટે UPI સ્વીકારનાર પ્રથમ UAEનું કયું પ્રવાસી આકર્ષણ બન્યું?
gu.explanation: 29 જુલાઈ, 2026 ના રોજ ઓનલાઈન ટિકિટ બુકિંગ માટે UPI સ્વીકારનાર બુર્જ ખલીફા સંયુક્ત આરબ અમીરાતમાં પ્રથમ પ્રવાસી આકર્ષણ બન્યું. આ પહેલ NPCI ઈન્ટરનેશનલ પેમેન્ટ્સ લિમિટેડ (NIPL), NEOPAY અને Emaar Entertainment વચ્ચેની ભાગીદારી દ્વારા શરૂ કરવામાં આવી હતી. તે GCC પ્રદેશમાં ઈ-કોમર્સ વ્યવહારો માટે UPI નો પ્રથમ ઉપયોગ ચિહ્નિત કરે છે, જેનાથી ભારતીય પ્રવાસીઓ દુબઈમાં આવતા પહેલા UPI એપ્સ દ્વારા ભારતીય ચલણમાં ટિકિટ ખરીદવા સક્ષમ બને છે. આ વિકાસ ભારતના ડિજિટલ પેમેન્ટ ઇકોસિસ્ટમની વૈશ્વિક પહોંચને વિસ્તૃત કરે છે.

en.question: Who won the silver medal in the men's 79kg weightlifting category at the Commonwealth Games 2026?
en.explanation: Ajaya Babu won the silver medal in the men's 79kg weightlifting event at the Commonwealth Games 2026 in Glasgow with a combined lift of 330kg, consisting of 149kg in the snatch and 181kg in the clean and jerk. He narrowly missed the gold medal by just 1kg, as Malaysia's Erry Hidayat Muhammad secured first place with a Games record total of 331kg. During the competition, Ajaya also equalled the Commonwealth Games record with his total lift. His silver medal became India's sixth weightlifting medal at the Games, further strengthening the country's reputation as a leading force in international weightlifting.

en.question: In which state will Raghu Vamsi Aerospace Group establish a ₹600 crore integrated nickel-based superalloy manufacturing facility?
en.explanation: Raghu Vamsi Aerospace Group announced a ₹600 crore investment to establish an integrated nickel-based superalloy manufacturing facility in Telangana on July 23, 2026. The 50-acre plant will have an annual production capacity of 5,000 tonnes, with commercial production expected to begin in January 2028. The facility will manufacture round bars, wires, forgings, castings, and tungsten carbide powders for strategic sectors such as aerospace, defence, nuclear energy, and gas turbines. Led by Dr. S.K. Jha, former CMD of MIDHANI, the project aims to strengthen India's self-reliance by reducing dependence on imported strategic materials and enhancing domestic supply-chain security.

en.question: Who won the silver medal in the men's high jump at the Commonwealth Games 2026?
en.explanation: Sarvesh Kushare won the silver medal in the men's high jump at the Commonwealth Games 2026 in Glasgow with a best jump of 2.25 metres. He cleared the height on his final attempt, demonstrating remarkable composure under pressure. Although he could not clear 2.28 metres, his performance earned him the first major multi-sport medal of his career. The achievement also surpassed India's previous best result of a bronze medal in the event at the Commonwealth Games. Earlier, Sarvesh had set a new Indian national record of 2.31 metres at the Inter-State Athletics Championships, confirming his place among the country's finest high jumpers.

en.question: Which state implements the Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY) for cashless healthcare?
en.explanation: The Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY) is a flagship health insurance scheme implemented by the Government of Maharashtra to provide cashless medical treatment to eligible families. Launched in 2012, the scheme covers hospitalisation expenses up to ₹1.5 lakh per family annually, with coverage increasing to ₹2.5 lakh for organ transplants. Families eligible under both MJPJAY and Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY can receive combined health insurance coverage of up to ₹5 lakh per year. The scheme includes 996 medical procedures across 34 specialities and is available through empanelled government and private hospitals, ensuring affordable and accessible healthcare for beneficiaries.

en.question: In which city were solar-electric passenger boats launched on the River Ganga under the Jal Marg Vikas Project?

en.question: Sarnath became India's which UNESCO World Heritage Site after its inscription in 2026?
en.explanation: Sarnath was inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List during the 48th session of the World Heritage Committee held on July 26, 2026. With this recognition, Sarnath became India's 45th UNESCO World Heritage Site and the country's 36th Cultural World Heritage Site. Located near Varanasi in Uttar Pradesh, Sarnath is one of Buddhism's holiest places, where Gautama Buddha delivered his first sermon to his first five disciples after attaining enlightenment. en.question: Which state launched the Water Plan 2047 roadmap to ensure long-term water security for domestic and agricultural needs?
en.explanation: Rajasthan launched the Water Plan 2047 under the leadership of Chief Minister Bhajan Lal Sharma to strengthen long-term water security across the state. The roadmap integrates the Eastern Rajasthan Canal Project (ERCP) with the Parbati-Kalisindh-Chambal river interlinking project to improve water availability. It also aims to achieve 100% drip and sprinkler-based micro-irrigation in desert districts by 2035, mandates rooftop rainwater harvesting systems for commercial and institutional buildings, and proposes transferring surplus river water from southern Rajasthan to arid western regions. The comprehensive plan focuses on sustainable water management, agricultural development, and improved access to water for future generations.

en.question: Which state will launch the ‘Mee Bhoomi–Blockchain’ pilot project to create a tamper-proof and integrated land records management system?
en.explanation: Andhra Pradesh is launching the ‘Mee Bhoomi–Blockchain’ pilot project across seven mandals to modernise land records using blockchain technology. The project integrates data from the revenue, survey, and registration departments into a single secure platform. Built using Hyperledger Fabric by NIC Andhra Pradesh and the Centre of Excellence in Blockchain Technology at NIC Bengaluru, it assigns a unique blockchain identity to each land parcel. The system supports citizen services such as auto-mutation, subdivision, and extent correction while automatically stopping transactions when data mismatches are detected. Every transaction is permanently recorded with the responsible official’s identity and timestamp, ensuring transparency, security, and protection against record tampering.

en.question: Which online code hosting platform was directed by the Indian Cybercrime Coordination Centre (I4C) to remove repositories related to the Bitchat messaging app over security concerns?
en.explanation: GitHub was directed by the Indian Cybercrime Coordination Centre (I4C), operating under the Ministry of Home Affairs, to remove repositories associated with the Bluetooth-based messaging app Bitchat. The action was taken under Section 79(3)(b) of the Information Technology Act, 2000, and Rule 3(1)(d) of the Information Technology Rules, 2021, citing national security concerns. Bitchat is a decentralised, open-source messaging application that uses Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) mesh networks instead of the internet or centralised servers. Authorities expressed concerns that its anonymous and offline communication capabilities could be misused by terrorists, cybercriminals, organised crime groups, and other anti-national elements, making monitoring and law enforcement more challenging.

en.question: When is Income Tax Day celebrated every year in India to commemorate the introduction of income tax by Sir James Wilson?
en.explanation: Income Tax Day is observed every year on July 24 to commemorate the introduction of income tax in India by Sir James Wilson on July 24, 1860. In 2026, the observance marks 167 years of India's income tax system. The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) officially began celebrating the day in 2010 to recognise the contributions of honest taxpayers and promote tax awareness. The occasion also highlights the transformation of India's tax administration from a paper-based system to a modern digital platform featuring online ITR filing, faceless assessments, e-verification, pre-filled tax returns, and faster refund processing, making compliance simpler, transparent, and taxpayer-friendly.

en.question: In which state did the ICMR i-DRONE study significantly reduce tuberculosis diagnosis time and patient costs?
en.explanation: The ICMR i-DRONE study was conducted in Telangana's Yadadri-Bhuvanagiri district in collaboration with AIIMS Bibinagar and the National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP). The initiative evaluated drone-assisted transport of sputum samples for tuberculosis diagnosis among 840 participants. It reduced the median diagnosis time from 15 days to just 5 days while significantly lowering patients' out-of-pocket expenditure from ₹9,451 to ₹91. en.question: Which country signed the Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) with India to strengthen bilateral trade and professional mobility?
en.explanation: The Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) became operational between India and the United Kingdom to strengthen bilateral trade, investment, and professional mobility. The agreement provides zero-duty access for 99% of India's export tariff lines, benefiting sectors such as processed foods, textiles, engineering goods, leather, chemicals, and pharmaceuticals. Along with CETA, the Double Contribution Convention (DCC) exempts Indian professionals from dual social security contributions and extends the exemption period for temporary workers from three to five years. These measures are expected to boost trade, support businesses, facilitate skilled professionals, and help achieve the bilateral trade target of USD 100 billion by 2030.

en.question: On which date is World Snake Day celebrated every year?
en.explanation: World Snake Day is celebrated annually on July 16 to raise awareness about snakes and their importance in maintaining ecological balance. The observance highlights the need to conserve snake species, protect their natural habitats, and educate people about their ecological role. Snakes help control rodent populations, support biodiversity, and maintain healthy food chains. The day also aims to dispel common myths and fears associated with snakes through educational programs and conservation initiatives. Since its recognition in 2009, World Snake Day has encouraged wildlife experts, conservationists, and environmental organisations worldwide to promote snake conservation and foster a better understanding of these important reptiles.

These trains use advanced Communication-Based Train Control (CBTC) technology, enabling automatic acceleration, braking, station stops, and door operations under continuous supervision from a central control room. The project also includes advanced safety features such as platform screen doors, smart signalling systems, emergency braking, and obstacle detection. The initiative is expected to improve operational efficiency, passenger safety, and the overall public transport experience in the city.

en.question: Which Indian state approved the new agricultural marketing law replacing the 1956 OAPM Act to establish a competitive farmer-centric system?
en.explanation: Odisha approved a new agricultural marketing law to replace the Odisha Agricultural Produce Markets (OAPM) Act, 1956, with the objective of creating a more competitive, transparent, and farmer-centric agricultural marketing system. The new legislation aligns the state's framework with the Centre's Model Agricultural Produce and Livestock Marketing Act, 2017. It promotes electronic trading, e-auctions, a unified statewide market, inter-state trade, and a single trading licence. The reforms also recognise warehouses, cold storages, and silos as market sub-yards while encouraging the participation of Farmer Producer Organisations, cooperatives, and self-help groups to improve market access for farmers.

en.question: When is World Population Day observed every year to raise awareness about population-related issues and sustainable development?
en.explanation: World Population Day is observed every year on July 11 to increase awareness about global population issues, including reproductive health, family planning, gender equality, youth empowerment, and sustainable development. Established by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) in 1989, the observance was inspired by the "Five Billion Day" milestone on July 11, 1987, when the world's population was estimated to have reached five billion. The day encourages governments, organisations, and individuals to promote informed decision-making, improve quality of life, ensure equitable access to resources, and support policies that contribute to balanced population growth and long-term sustainability.

en.question: What is the name of the world's first once-weekly basal insulin launched in India for the treatment of adult diabetes?
en.explanation: Awiqli, developed by Novo Nordisk, is the world's first once-weekly basal insulin introduced in India for the treatment of adult diabetes. The medicine is designed to reduce the burden of daily insulin injections by requiring only one injection every week, reducing the annual number of injections from 365 to 52. It is administered through a pre-filled pen device and works by binding to the blood protein albumin, which creates a reservoir that releases insulin steadily over seven days. This helps maintain stable blood glucose levels and improves treatment convenience. Awiqli can be used by eligible patients with Type 2 diabetes either alone or with other medicines, while patients with Type 1 diabetes must use it together with short-acting insulin during mealtimes.

en.question: Which university led the team that announced the discovery of the potentially habitable exoplanet GJ 3378b?
en.explanation: The discovery of the potentially habitable Super-Earth GJ 3378b was announced by a team of astronomers led by the University of California, Irvine. Located about 25 light-years from Earth, the rocky exoplanet orbits a red dwarf star within the habitable "Goldilocks" zone, where conditions may allow liquid water to exist. The planet has an estimated mass of 2.3 times that of Earth and was identified using advanced instruments, including the Habitable-zone Planet Finder and the NEID spectrometer. Future NASA missions are expected to study its atmosphere for possible biosignatures and signs of habitability.

en.question: Which state's Natural History Museum was designated as India's 21st Designated Repository under the Biological Diversity Act, 2002?

en.question: On which date is World Zoonoses Day observed annually?
en.explanation: World Zoonoses Day is observed every year on July 6 to raise global awareness about zoonotic diseases, which are infections that transmit between animals and humans. This specific date holds historical significance because it commemorates the successful administration of the first rabies vaccine by French microbiologist Louis Pasteur on July 6, 1885. Pasteur's groundbreaking vaccination saved the life of a young boy bitten by a rabid dog and marked a monumental milestone in medical science, laying the foundation for modern vaccine development against infectious diseases. The day emphasises the importance of prevention, early detection, and coordinated action through the One Health approach, which recognises the interconnected health of humans, animals, and the environment.

en.explanation: GST Day is observed every year on July 01 to mark the implementation of the Goods and Services Tax (GST) in 2017. Introduced under the vision of "One Nation, One Tax," GST replaced multiple central and state indirect taxes with a unified tax system, simplifying taxation and creating a common national market. Introduced under the vision of "One Nation, One Tax," GST replaced multiple central and state indirect taxes with a unified tax system, simplifying taxation and creating a common national market. Over the years, GST has strengthened cooperative federalism, improved tax compliance through digital governance, and enhanced transparency. Recent GST 2.0 reforms have further simplified tax rates, eased compliance for businesses, especially MSMEs, and promoted economic growth through technology-driven tax administration and improved ease of doing business.

en.question: Who assumed charge as India's 31st Chief of the Army Staff (COAS) on July 1, 2026?
en.explanation: General Dhiraj Seth assumed charge as India's 31st Chief of the Army Staff (COAS) on July 1, 2026, succeeding General Upendra Dwivedi. Upon taking office, he unveiled the "VIJAY" vision, a comprehensive roadmap focused on building a technology-driven, future-ready, and self-reliant Indian Army. The vision emphasises Vigilance and Readiness, Innovation and Transformation, Jointness and Integration, Aatmanirbharta, and Yoddha First. A 1986-batch Armoured Corps officer with nearly four decades of distinguished service, General Seth has commanded several key formations, including the South Western Command and Southern Command, contributing significantly to India's defence preparedness and military modernisation.

en.question: On which date is CA Day (Chartered Accountants Day) celebrated every year in India?
en.explanation: CA Day, also known as Chartered Accountants Day, is celebrated every year on July 01 to commemorate the establishment of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) in 1949 under the Chartered Accountants Act, 1949. In 2026, ICAI celebrates its 77th Foundation Day, recognising the invaluable contributions of Chartered Accountants to India's financial governance, transparency, and economic development. The occasion is marked by seminars, conferences, award ceremonies, and professional development programmes across the country. It also highlights ICAI's role in regulating the accounting profession, setting auditing standards, and promoting ethical financial practices.

en.question: In which river was the new pollution-eating bacteria Brachybacterium netajii discovered by researchers?
en.explanation: Researchers discovered a new species of pollution-eating bacteria, Brachybacterium netajii, in the Hooghly River, West Bengal, on June 26, 2026. The discovery was made through a collaborative effort involving Netaji Mahavidyalaya, the University of Burdwan, IIT (BHU), and Hiroshima University, Japan. The bacterium can degrade p-nitrophenol (PNP), a toxic industrial pollutant, by using it as a source of carbon and energy. It also shows remarkable resistance to heavy metals such as arsenic, cadmium, lead, and mercury and can tolerate high salinity. The species was named in honour of Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose for his contributions to scientific and technological advancement.

en.question: Which company signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Ministry of Tourism to strengthen the digital promotion of Indian tourism?
en.explanation: The Ministry of Tourism signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Google India Pvt. Ltd. to enhance the digital visibility of India's tourism destinations through advanced technologies. The partnership focuses on using artificial intelligence (AI), digital marketing, data-driven insights, and capacity building to improve visitor engagement and promote the Incredible India campaign. The agreement is non-commercial, non-binding, and has no financial implications for either party. By leveraging Google's digital ecosystem, the collaboration aims to showcase India's cultural, historical, spiritual, and natural attractions more effectively, strengthen global tourism outreach, and support the country's broader goals of digital transformation and sustainable tourism development.

en.question: What was the year-on-year growth rate of India's gross GST collections in June 2026?
en.explanation: India's gross GST collections recorded a year-on-year growth of 13.9% in June 2026, reaching ₹1,94,812 crore compared to ₹1,71,105 crore in June 2025. After accounting for refunds, net GST collections stood at ₹1,62,377 crore, reflecting an annual growth of 11.2%. The increase was driven mainly by strong import-related GST revenue, which surged by 34.6%, while domestic GST collections grew by 6.5%. The robust revenue performance highlights improved tax compliance, effective digital tax administration, and sustained economic activity despite global uncertainties, reinforcing the strength of India's GST framework.

en.question: Who has been reappointed as the Chairman of the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) for a six-month term effective from July 1, 2026?
en.explanation: Ravi Agrawal has been reappointed as the Chairman of the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) for a further six-month term from July 1, 2026, to December 31, 2026. A 1988-batch Indian Revenue Service (IRS) officer, his extension was approved by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC) after his scheduled retirement. The CBDT is the apex policymaking body for direct taxes in India and functions under the Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance. It is responsible for formulating direct tax policies, improving tax administration, combating tax evasion, issuing income tax guidelines, and enhancing transparency and taxpayer services across the country.

en.question: In which country is the Unified Payments Interface (UPI) expected to become operational by the end of 2026?
en.explanation: The Unified Payments Interface (UPI) is expected to become operational in the Seychelles by the end of 2026, as announced by Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri. The initiative reflects the growing strategic and economic partnership between India and Seychelles. Besides digital payment integration, the two countries cooperate in areas such as health, education, renewable energy, and social infrastructure. Maritime security remains a major focus to address challenges like illegal fishing, piracy, and drug trafficking in the Indian Ocean Region. Both nations are also exploring a Comprehensive Economic Partnership to strengthen bilateral trade and reviewing development projects supported under India's Special Economic Package.
